# netactuate_boot_profiles (Data Source)

Reads Boot Profiles visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_boot_profiles" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `boot_profiles` (List of Object) List of cloud boot profiles. The API field named id is exposed as boot_profile_id because Terraform reserves id for resource state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--boot_profiles))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--boot_profiles"></a>
